left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Adults age  [AND] 55-90 years with visual significant cataracts in one  [OR] or both eyes
-  Healthy individuals able to tolerate outpatient cataract surgery under local anesthesia via either phacoemulsification  [OR] and/or femtosecond assisted cataract surgery

right.raw_text: Well-controlled diabetes, [OR]  hypertension will be included

left.raw_text: -  Females of childbearing potential must agree to use a reliable method of birth control while participating in this study

Reliable methods of birth control are: abstinence, [OR]  oral contraceptives, [OR]  intrauterine device (IUD), DepoProvera, [OR]  tubal ligation  [OR] or vasectomy  [AND]  [AND] of the partner (with confirmed negative sperm counts) in monogamous relationship (same partner)

right.raw_text: An acceptable, although less reliable, method involves the careful use of condoms  [OR] and spermicidal  [OR] foam  [OR] or gel and/or cervical cap  [OR] or sponge

left.raw_text: A pregnancy test is required at least 10 days from the last normal menstrual period, if the patient is a sexually active female  [AND] of childbearing potential

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Allergy to Phenylephrine  [OR] or NSAIDs

right.raw_text: -  Inability to sit steady  [AND] and upright for the Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT)

left.raw_text: -  Complications during surgery, including posterior capsular rupture, [OR]  vitreous loss, [OR]  zonular dialysis, [OR]  or iris trauma

right.raw_text:
-  Macular thickness above 300 microns at baseline
  -  Currently taking a prostaglandin analogue
  -  Presence of an epiretinal membrane on the preoperative OCT

-  Inability to return for follow appointments
  -  Female  [AND] patients who are pregnant, [OR]  lactating  [OR] or planning to become pregnant during the course of treatment
